theme: Finding themes and dated knowledge navigation
question: Can every finding and the later October programmes be found through a themed guide and dated evidence links?
outcome: Organized 47 findings in ten themes, including nine new source-qualified cards. Added fourteen conjecture links to the working model and organized 104 completed dated packages into 45 programme groups. Preserved existing card claims and recorded the limited frontmatter quoting edits. Inventory, link, guide, prose and knowledge checks are saved in the package.
challenge: Later passes and reviews use different scopes and baselines; historical prose and generated navigation must be preserved while concurrent runs own other paths.
remedy: Use exact report versions and source locations, copy original package authors, retain uncarded results with their statuses, group related passes, and check card coverage, link resolution and preservation independently of shared generated files.
retry_when: A new result or review changes the source chain, a package needs a finding card, or a navigation check reports a missing or duplicate result.
